# HEM v0.6.2b2 — Door settings together and concise dashboard names

This is a dashboard-only usability update; existing door/Eco control policy is unchanged.

- Move room door contacts out of Presence into **Windows, doors, ventilation and shading**. Greek: **Παράθυρα, πόρτες, αερισμός και σκίαση**. German: **Fenster, Türen, Lüftung und Beschattung**.
- Place the existing closed-door Eco switch immediately below the door-contact selector, before shades. Show it once and retain its original native switch service. Door selections still use the existing Room Save flow.
- Resolve concise setting names consistently in Home, Room and Device menus, mode controls and quick-control help. Remove matching room/device/Environment and redundant category prefixes, including fallback names without metadata and unavailable entities.
- Preserve meaningful profile/mode distinctions, units, custom names, entity identities, selected sources and all authorization checks. Recognize HA entity registry `name`, `original_name_unprefixed`, original names and translated setting metadata.
- Reuse the already fetched device registry; no additional polling or network requests. Keep unsaved selections, focus, expanded help and category state during refresh.

## Verification
Production Chromium tests cover EN/EL/DE at 320, 390 and 760 px, exact selector/Eco order, no duplicates, prefix fallbacks, custom names, profile distinctions, actual guarded service targets and unchanged Options Save payloads. Existing menu, help, mode, registry and controller regressions remain required.

No new door automation, configuration migration, appliance command, or HACS packaging change is introduced by this UI update.
